text: 下面进入小作文 03 · 求职与自荐信：国际学术研讨会学生助理自荐答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：交待招聘信息来源与自荐岗位。
Learning that student assistants are wanted for the upcoming International Academic Symposium, I am writing to recommend myself with utmost enthusiasm.
分词短语作状语：Learning from... that..., I am writing to...
I am writing to recommend myself with utmost enthusiasm.
第二段：多角度论证个人优势（语言能力 + 会务经验 + 敬业态度）。
First of all, I have achieved excellent proficiency in English, which enables me to communicate fluently with foreign scholars.
分词作状语表达经验：Having served as a liaison officer, I possess sound organizational capabilities.
Having served as a liaison officer, I possess sound organizational capabilities.
第三段：提交履历材料并礼貌表达面试期盼。
Enclosed please find my curriculum vitae for your reference, and I would appreciate the opportunity to attend an interview at your convenience.
商务信函固定高分句：Enclosed please find my resume for your reference.
Enclosed please find my curriculum vitae for your reference.
